file-preview.description: Make the preview of a file on this machine. An image comes scaled to max_px on its long side, a PDF page and a film frame as an image (with pdftoppm and ffmpeg there), text as its first 256 KiB, and anything else as its type and size.

params.name: path
params.description: The file. An absolute path, or one that starts with ~.

params.name: max_px
params.description: The longest side of an image, at most 4096.

params.name: pages_known
params.description: The caller knows the page count, so pdfinfo does not run.

params.name: words
params.description: Send the PDF page's words from pdftotext in place of its picture.

params.name: at_ms
params.description: The position in a film of the frame to send. Without it the frame is 5 % in.

params.name: duration_known
params.description: The caller knows the film's facts, so ffprobe does not run.

params.name: format
params.description: Lay out a JSON file for reading.

params.name: details
params.description: Send the file's permissions, what git says of it, its diff and a PDF page's words, in place of the preview.

params.name: offset
params.description: Send a window of a text file from this byte, whole lines only, in place of the preview.

params.name: limit
params.description: The most bytes in that window, at most 1 MiB.

params.name: find
params.description: Look for this text in a text file, in place of the preview. Lower case ignores case.

params.name: back
params.description: Find goes toward the start of the file.

params.name: line
params.description: Find the start of this line number, in place of the preview.

returns.name: kind
returns.description: image, svg, pdf, video, text, dir or binary.

returns.name: image
returns.description: The picture, base64, as mime says: the image, the page or the frame.

returns.name: mime
returns.description: The picture's type for image, pdf and video, and the file's type otherwise.

returns.name: width
returns.description: An image's own width.

returns.name: height
returns.description: An image's own height.

returns.name: text
returns.description: text and svg: the content.

returns.name: truncated
returns.description: text: the file is longer than what was sent.

returns.name: offset
returns.description: A window: the byte it starts at. find and line: the start of the line found, or -1.

returns.name: reached
returns.description: find and line: how far the read went. Call again from there when the search ran out of time.

returns.name: counted
returns.description: line: the lines passed.

returns.name: next_offset
returns.description: A window: the byte the next window starts at.

returns.name: pdf
returns.description: pdf, when this machine cannot draw the page: the file, base64, at most 8 MiB.

returns.name: pages
returns.description: pdf: the page count, when pdfinfo is there.

returns.name: words
returns.description: pdf, when asked for: the page's words.

returns.name: no_tool
returns.description: pdf: the tool this machine needs and does not have.

returns.name: at_ms
returns.description: video: the position of the frame sent.

returns.name: formatted
returns.description: text: the JSON was laid out.

returns.name: entries
returns.description: archive: the listing, with name, size and dir.

returns.name: capped
returns.description: archive: the listing stopped at a bound.

returns.name: head
returns.description: binary: the first 16 KiB, base64.

returns.name: details
returns.description: The reply holds the details asked for.

returns.name: mode
returns.description: details: the permissions.

returns.name: owner
returns.description: details: the file's owner.

returns.name: group
returns.description: details: the file's group.

returns.name: git
returns.description: details: what git says of the file.

returns.name: diff
returns.description: details: the diff of a changed file.

returns.name: video_codec
returns.description: video: the codec, from ffprobe.

returns.name: audio_codec
returns.description: video: the codec of the sound, from ffprobe, when it has sound.

returns.name: fps
returns.description: video: the frames each second, from ffprobe.

returns.name: duration_ms
returns.description: video: the length.

returns.name: note
returns.description: Why there is no picture, in words a person can act on.

returns.name: size
returns.description: The file's size.

returns.name: mtime
returns.description: The file's modification time, Unix ms.

returns.name: previewers
returns.description: The names of this machine's quick look previewers that match the file, in order. Absent when none does. file-preview-run runs one.
